SELECT id, stocks_id, stocks_shortname, bar_start_time, reference_price, ma1d, ma7d, ma30d, zscore1d, zscore7d, zscore30d, return6h, return1d, return7d, return14d, low30d, high30d, width30d, position30, pct_above_30d_low, pct_below_30d_high, strategy_ready, data_quality_reason, feature_version, deleted, create_time, update_time FROM torn_stock_strategy_feature_15m WHERE bar_start_time >= #{startTime} AND bar_start_time <= #{endTime} AND feature_version = #{featureVersion} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY stocks_id ASC, bar_start_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torn_stock_strategy_feature_15m (stocks_id, stocks_shortname, bar_start_time, reference_price, ma1d, ma7d, ma30d, zscore1d, zscore7d, zscore30d, return6h, return1d, return7d, return14d, low30d, high30d, width30d, position30, pct_above_30d_low, pct_below_30d_high, strategy_ready, data_quality_reason, feature_version, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{feature.stocksId}, #{feature.stocksShortname}, #{feature.barStartTime}, #{feature.referencePrice}, #{feature.ma1d}, #{feature.ma7d}, #{feature.ma30d}, #{feature.zscore1d}, #{feature.zscore7d}, #{feature.zscore30d}, #{feature.return6h}, #{feature.return1d}, #{feature.return7d}, #{feature.return14d}, #{feature.low30d}, #{feature.high30d}, #{feature.width30d}, #{feature.position30}, #{feature.pctAbove30dLow}, #{feature.pctBelow30dHigh}, #{feature.strategyReady}, #{feature.dataQualityReason}, #{feature.featureVersion}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (stocks_id, bar_start_time, feature_version) WHERE deleted = 0 DO UPDATE SET stocks_shortname = EXCLUDED.stocks_shortname, reference_price = EXCLUDED.reference_price, ma1d = EXCLUDED.ma1d, ma7d = EXCLUDED.ma7d, ma30d = EXCLUDED.ma30d, zscore1d = EXCLUDED.zscore1d, zscore7d = EXCLUDED.zscore7d, zscore30d = EXCLUDED.zscore30d, return6h = EXCLUDED.return6h, return1d = EXCLUDED.return1d, return7d = EXCLUDED.return7d, return14d = EXCLUDED.return14d, low30d = EXCLUDED.low30d, high30d = EXCLUDED.high30d, width30d = EXCLUDED.width30d, position30 = EXCLUDED.position30, pct_above_30d_low = EXCLUDED.pct_above_30d_low, pct_below_30d_high = EXCLUDED.pct_below_30d_high, strategy_ready = EXCLUDED.strategy_ready, data_quality_reason = EXCLUDED.data_quality_reason, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
